content.body:
Once disregarded as an effective fighter, the Bf 110C-4/B was fitted with a bomb rack and became the first true fighter/bomber in history. While fairing slightly better at this task the 110's true time in the sun would not come until it was pitted against the huge formations of USAAF B-17's and B-24's in the Luftwaffe's final gasp, gunned up as a heavy bomber destroyer.
Its the same as the earlier Bf 110 but you have a couple of very potent bombs on board and an extra 200hp (100 for each engine) to lug them around with. Use the C-4/B as a support fighter against mechanized infantry and light tanks. The 250 kg bomb can peel open just about any Allied tank. Take a friend along as your tail gunner when you are in a support role to help keep your tail clear and add some insult to injury as you pull off a bomb or strafing run.
Bf 110's were often referred to as "Zerstörers" ("Destroyers"), while the term "Jabo," short for "Jaeger Bomber" ("Fighter Bomber"), can mean any fighter that performed that role.
The following crew positions are controllable: 1 Pilot 2 Tail Gunner
content.brief: TYPE: Ground Attack MAX. SPEED: 533 km/h WEIGHT: 6,845 kg CREW: 2 ARMAMENT: 20 mm MGFF Cannons (2) 7.92 mm MG17 LMGs (4) 7.92 mm MG15 LMGs (1) SC250 250 kg Bombs (2)
